title: Bridgeport Harbor Marina

services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: The Steelpointe Yacht & Boat Show, known this year as Steelpointe25, delivered a memorable experience over the weekend at Bridgeport Harbor Marina. Set against a backdrop of waterfront luxury, the event featured an elite lineup of yachts and boats from renowned brands like Pardo, Absolute, Prestige, Valhalla, and Scout. The event was invitation-only, giving attendees exclusive access to explore vessels in an upscale, relaxed setting. But the show wasn’t just about yachts, it was also about high-energy entertainment.
